transcript.text: So yesterday I made some jacket potatoes on the grill. It was probably honestly the best potatoes ever made in my life. It was confusingly good. And so it first went on to the grill for an hour and a half in the aluminum wrap float where it got flipped every 15 minutes. And then after the hour and a half, took it off, sliced off the top, scooped all the inside, mixed it into a bowl with a bunch of butter and a bunch of cream and a bunch of bacon and sliced spring onions. That all got mixed together and then scooped back into the shell of the potato that had been scooped out from. And then with extra cheese and bacon on top and sauce from a flesquistide that we also made from Mother's Day.
